method: **Ingredients:** Gram Flour - 1 cup, Grated Coconut - 1 cup, Milk - 1 cup, Ghee or Dalda - 1 cup, Sugar - 2 cups.
**Method:** Add all the ingredients together in a heavy-bottomed vessel.
Keep stirring the mixture continuously over heat.
Once it thickens and reaches the right consistency, pour it into a ghee-greased tray.
Cut it into pieces using a knife.
**Ingredients:** Grated Coconut - 3 cups, Sugar - 2.5 cups, Milk - 0.75 cup, Color and Essence - a little.
**Method:** Mix the milk and sugar well.
Add the grated coconut into it and keep stirring over heat until it thickens and solidifies.
Add the color and essence, pour it onto a tray, and cut it into pieces.
